notes.title: Cyber Paradise Debuts a Medieval Bonus Area at London Games Festival (3-4 April)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

🎉 We're proud to announce that
[h2]Cyber Paradise has been officially selected for London Games Festival (LGF)![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/076383a66c079d8201f2c6161660863c9be6cf0e.png[/img]

Exhibition details at the end!

To celebrate, we're debuting a new Robin Hood's Medieval England area in the demo at the festival, created in collaboration with Red Rebellion.

[h2]Cyber Paradise Special Edition Demo – Addition of a Robin Hood’s Medieval England-Themed Area[/h2]

This content is brought to you with the historically researched background of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/]Red Rebellion[/url], a narrative adventure game set in medieval England where female Robin Hood and Red Riding Hood team up to save their town. Experience the intriguing history of medieval England in this cyberpunk simulation!

Example scene:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/ba5a351d383be69158778685620b161961dc837e.png[/img]
▲The Red Rebellion team spent years researching the setting, even consulting a British medievalist professor and historian to ensure historical accuracy. This dog-powered rotisserie is one of the fun facts they provided for the crossover.

[b]More about Red Rebellion:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/

[h2]London Games Festival – Exhibition Details[/h2]
Venue: New Game Plus, London Museum Spaces, 150 London Wall, EC2Y 5HN
Date: 3rd- 4th April, 2025, 10 am - 6 pm

Get your ticket here: [url=tickets.games.london]tickets.games.london[/url]

Note: Unfortunately, Cyber Paradise will be exhibited without the dev team present. So you will not see us there.

[h2]Special Edition Demo Release on Steam – April 5[/h2]
Can’t make it to LGF? Don’t worry — the special edition demo will be available here on Steam right after the event!
Be sure to check it out and let us know what you think!

notes.title: 🚀 Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO Thriving on Steam Deck At BitSummit! 🚀
notes.notes:
We just wrapped up an intense 3-day marathon at BitSummit in Japan, and it was nothing short of legendary! We hooked up a Steam Deck to a monitor and put Cyber Paradise to the ultimate test.

For three epic days, from 10 AM to 5 PM, our booth was swarmed with enthusiastic gamers! The Steam Deck held up like a champ, powering through continuous gameplay without breaking a sweat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/018a2bbaf543be93a7f0f4bb4e146647b6745662.jpg[/img]

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 AM to 5 PM: Non-stop action (almost!).
[*] 3 Days: Of near-continuous play sessions.
[*] Steam Deck: Proving Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO is not just playable but thrives on it!
[/list]

If you ever doubted the Steam Deck’s capabilities, doubt no more! Cyber Paradise is totally compatible with Steam Deck. Get ready to dive into a world of non-stop cyberpunk action, whether you’re at home or on the go.

[b]PS1:[/b] This announcement exists because Steam requires a Steam Event posting to provide Steam Deck compatibility info. We just want to let you know… yeah… Cyber Paradise is totally playable on Steam Deck (with cloud save)!

[b]PS2:[/b] It was a blast at BitSummit. Presses came by, we were interviewed and there are now at least 14 pieces of media coverage on Cyber Paradise from multiple countries! We can't be more grateful! Check out the pieces at [url=https://cyberparadise.net/]https://cyberparadise.net/[/url]!

[b]PS3:[/b] If you missed our previous announcement on the launch of Cyber Paradise's NEW DEMO, here's the launch trailer:
[previewyoutube=zB8lJyHZMOY;full][/previewyoutube]
Play it now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise/

[b]PS4:[/b] As mentioned in the previous announcement, CyberParadise will be part of the #PixElatedFestival starting in 4 days, hosted by [url=https://x.com/BraveAtNight]Brave At Night[/url] 
Visit [url=http://pixelatedfest.com]http://pixelatedfest.com[/url] for the complete line-up of games!

notes.title: 🚨Brand-New BitSummit Demo Out NOW🚨
notes.notes:
🚨Brand-New BitSummit Demo Out NOW🚨
🔥More Atmospheric, Tighter Storytelling, and Escalating Combats
🌃New Biomes, New Music and Retro Cultural Fusion

[h2][b]New Demo Launch Trailer:[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=zB8lJyHZMOY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise/][h1]Play Now[/h1][/url]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise/?snr=1_1056_4_creator_curator-tabs&curator_clanid=40274833

[h2][b]More Atmospheric, Tighter Storytelling, and Escalating Combats[/b][/h2]

After showcasing at multiple festivals and extensive playtesting over the past year, the demo has undergone some major revamps. The original 3-hour demo is now condensed into a 20-30-minute experience of heartfelt stories, escalating battles, and an atmospheric cyberpunk setting, allowing players to quickly grasp the essence of the game. For those craving more lore, the old demo remains hidden in a secret area within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/a1f837f5b94ae807df6eda588841894d6bf763be.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Biomes, New Music and Retro Cultural Fusion[/b][/h2]

In addition to the original azure harbour biome, the updated version introduces new environments inspired by the devs' hometowns, featuring classic Hong Kong architecture, colonial British buildings, and nostalgic Taiwanese street food. Imagine a sprawling urban landscape with hovering drones, a steampunk industrial atmosphere, the distant clatter of construction machinery, and shadowy, neon-lit alleys. The murmurs of distant crowds enhance the ambience, all set to new music with a moody, atmospheric vibe and subtle electronic beats, creating a striking contrast between the vibrant city life and the cyberpunk setting's gritty undertones.

The team is now collaborating with the notable US pixel artist Blueeyes Norton, who has contributed several pieces of concept art and a new cover for the game. His unique art style inspired the new demo's visuals, which have been carefully adapted to incorporate his distinctive artistic influence.

Blueeyes Norton's IG:[url=https://www.instagram.com/blueeyesnorton/]https://www.instagram.com/blueeyesnorton/[/url]

notes.title: [Demo Launch] Dog Digital Revival Adventure & Epic Crossover
notes.notes:
[b][Demo Launch] Cyber Paradise - Dog Digital Revival Adventure & All You Can Pet/Eat/Etc Crossover with 5 Games. (Dog Butt-Sniffing Included)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/2d10eb0d272448be34ed301a4eced2a88fc2f16b.png[/img]

TL;DR: Yes, you can pet them!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431790/Cyber_Paradise

[b]Funny Yet Heartfelt Narrative Weaved with Roguelite Mechanics[/b]

DDmeow Games, announces the release of the "Cyber Paradise Demo" on January 19th. This neon-drenched 2D action roguelite revolves around the digital revival of Mini the Dog. Players will engage in frenetic combats on a quest to uncover Mini's memories, and in between battles, they have the chance to bond with Mini's friends in the cozy setting of Mini's Café.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/bec3d7a657a6bef02e9fa321f7450f4439266836.png[/img]

Upon collecting enough of Mini's memories, players can digitally revive the dog. Additionally, players can also craft items from Mini's favorite memories. For instance, if players uncover a memory of Mini sniffing a dog's butt, they can recreate a dog butt in Mini's Cyber Paradise where Mini will happily sniff it and show contentment.

The narrative unfolds in two primary areas: within Mini's memories, players delve into the backstories of various characters and past mysteries of this dystopian world from the dog's unique perspective; and in Mini's Café, where each visit strengthens relationships with these characters through funny yet heartfelt dialogues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44328944/de847c0b0f1e5f489be34c5a1fb1d17c633c0359.png[/img]

[b]All You Can Pet/Eat/Etc with an Epic Crossover of 5 Games[/b]
In celebrating the return of Mini the Dog, this demo includes a special collaboration with 5 games. This crossover will happen at the end of the "Cyber Paradise" demo, giving players a chance to pet/eat/interact with all the animals and food from the participating games' worlds as part of the festivities. A list of participating games is at the bottom of this press release.

[b]Well Received at Early Demo Stage[/b]
The alpha demo has already received multiple awards and one nomination, such as Best Game Direction and [url=https://cyberparadise.net/en/#awards]more[/url].

The narration has been described as "heartfelt and funny" and the mechanics as "ridiculously fun" by [url=https://cyberparadise.net/en/#reviews]media and playtesters.[/url]

[b]Releasing As An Open Alpha Demo for Wider Community Testing[/b]

Since its debut in September last year, the closed-alpha demo of 'Cyber Paradise' has been rigorously playtested and streamed, with the count exceeding over 100 sessions. This iterative process has resulted in over 100 new, improved versions of the game. Sze, the developer, emphasizes, 'These weren't just minor bug fixes. The game has undergone several fundamental changes. Each playthrough brought fresh insights, significantly propelling the game's evolution.' 

"This journey has been a collaborative effort, greatly supported by fellow game developers, streamers, and playtesters. We're now thrilled to present the open-alpha demo, inviting a wider audience to experience and actively contribute to the ongoing development of 'Cyber Paradise'. The game will undergo further changes for sure, and the team is excited to see where this large-scale playtest will lead the game."

[b]Participating Games:[/b]
A Summer's End - Hong Kong 1986: A visual novel set in a vibrant 1980s Hong Kong, exploring the romance between two women against a backdrop of retro art and fashion.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1111370/A_Summers_End__Hong_Kong_1986/
https://www.asummersend.com/

Omi Oh My AI: Embark on a Captchavating adventure with Omi the dog loving AI, solve over 100 unique puzzles, and learn to see the world the way AI do.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867110/Omi_Oh_My_AI/

Red Rebellion: A sapphic yuri fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their village in this historical fantasy.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2114160/Red_Rebellion/
https://redrebellion.net/

Doggy Don't Care: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup left at home alone!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438180/Doggy_Dont_Care/

Foodomina: Narrative Driven, Sci-Fi Food Themed Pixel RPG where you play as two cute food girls and battle... MOLD! Or maybe not?
